meaning: 把日常小事变得特别有意义
usageNote: 动词短语，生活场景超常用！表示给平淡日子加点仪式感，语气积极温暖～

examples.en: She always turns a normal daily activity into something special by lighting candles during dinner.
examples.zh: 她总是在晚餐时点上蜡烛，把普通用餐变得特别有意义。

examples.en: A little music can turn a normal daily activity into something special.
examples.zh: 一点背景音乐就能让日常活动变得与众不同。
